messages.author: f0f1270d8b55f174
messages.subject: setWavPlayer in mac
parts:
Hi folks,
Finally I installed seewave in my mac. But now I have a new problem. I´m creating pure tones, but when I try to listen these tones, I can´t. 
I have set the wav player in this way (setWavPlayer("~/Applications/Utilities/QuickTime Player 7")), but when I checked the wavplayer with findwavplayer says "No standard wav player known for your system.\n".
How can I set the wav player? any suggestion?
Thanks in advance,
Oscar Laverde. 


function () 

{

    command <- switch(R.Version()$os, `linux-gnu` = c("play", 

        "playwave"), Win32 = "mplay32 /play", mingw32 = "mplay32 /play", 

        darwin8.6.0 = "open -a 'QuickTime Player'", darwin8.6.1 = "open -a 'QuickTime Player'", 

        default = NULL)

    if (is.null(command)) 

        warning("No standard wav player known for your system.\n")

    return(command)

}

<environment: namespace:sound>

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] setWavPlayer in mac
parts:
Hi Oscar,

The following works for at least some Macs:

setWavPlayer("afplay")

Regards,
Jesse Ross
